description: RFC 9457 Problem Details object. Some problems carry additional camelCase members, e.g. `expectedOffset` and `providedOffset` (409 on a resumable upload) or `totalLength`, `requestedStart` and `requestedEnd` (416 on a file range request).

instance.description: Identifies this occurrence of the problem. The id is the request id of the application log (`requestId`) and of the web server access log (`request_id`).

expectedOffset.description: 409 on a resumable upload: the offset the upload is currently at.

providedOffset.description: 409 on a resumable upload: the offset which was sent with the request.

totalLength.description: 416 on a file range request: the length of the file in bytes.

requestedStart.description: 416 on a file range request: the requested first byte.

requestedEnd.description: 416 on a file range request: the requested last byte.
